# Compare Two Texts

> Compare and edit text and documents in the browser. Official website: https://comparetwotexts.pro/.

The website and browser extension are free to use. The pricing page describes current terms and limits. PDF comparison requires selectable text; scanned pages and image comparison are not supported. Word and Google Docs add-ins are separately installed prototypes with their own limits and data handling.

## Product

- [Document workspace](https://comparetwotexts.pro/): Compare documents, review differences and download results.
- [Pricing and limits](https://comparetwotexts.pro/pricing/): Current free offering, file limits and account requirements.
- [Browser extension](https://comparetwotexts.pro/extension/): Installation options and offline workspace information.
- [Word and Google Docs add-ins](https://comparetwotexts.pro/office-addins/): Prototype installation, supported selections and data handling.

## File guides

- [Word documents](https://comparetwotexts.pro/compare-word-documents/): Compare downloaded document versions.
- [PDF files](https://comparetwotexts.pro/compare-pdf-files/): Compare text-based PDFs and review format limitations.
- [Excel files](https://comparetwotexts.pro/compare-excel-files/): Compare spreadsheet rows and cells.
- [CSV files](https://comparetwotexts.pro/compare-csv-files/): Compare delimited tables.

## Help and policies

- [Help and feedback](https://comparetwotexts.pro/support/): File guides, supported operations and limitations.
- [Your files and privacy](https://comparetwotexts.pro/privacy/): Document processing, local drafts and website analytics.
- [Terms of use](https://comparetwotexts.pro/terms/): Product licensing and third-party notices.
